name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Can you believe that, after all the trouble we have in the plaguelands... we have to worry about thieves too?  And not just normal thieves, troll thieves.

And not just normal troll thieves.  Dead troll thieves!

They're led by this big, dead troll named Zaeldarr the Outcast, and they come here at night and steal bodies from the pit below, then take them back to their evil, dead troll hideout--the Undercroft to the west.

Go there and take out Zaeldarr, adventurer.  I'm sick to death of his mischief!
narrative.objectives: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.
narrative.offerRewardText: Great, you got him! And I hope you taught his gang a lesson too!
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you find the hideout, adventurer? Did you take care of Zaeldarr?
